baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَعْتَدْنَا with سَلَاسِلَ, أَغْلَالًا, and سَعِيرًا
baseline_models.mechanism: The preparation verb governs a coordinated restraint system: linked chains control extension, collars bind the body, and blaze supplies the terminal environment. The split root mapping adds both deliberate provisioning and already-present readiness.

activation_trace.role: Prepared-and-present readiness makes the listed punishment a prepositioned apparatus rather than an improvised reaction.
Readying provisions supplies the functional act that organizes the three following objects as equipment held for use.
Successively connected links provide the serial restraint component of the apparatus.
A collar binding a limb localizes the restraint on the body.
Kindled blazing fire supplies the active thermal environment around the fixed body.

changed_reading.before: A list of three punishments for an already named group.
changed_reading.after: A deliberately provisioned system whose linked, bodily, and environmental components work together to immobilize and expose.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لِلْكَافِرِينَ followed by linked chains and binding collars
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch image of covering in ك ف ر is answered spatially by successive forms of enclosure: chain links surround and restrict movement, while collars close around the body. This is a focus-internal measure-for-measure reading, not a replacement translation of كافر.

activation_trace.role: Covering and concealment supply the initiating spatial action that the punishments answer with physical enclosure.
Covering or rejecting truth keeps the spatial image attached to the ayah's human designation.
Connected rings convert concealment into an extended enclosing structure.
The collar closes the answering enclosure directly around a limb or neck.

changed_reading.before: Kafirin functions only as a conventional class label before the punishment list.
changed_reading.after: The class label retains a covering action that is spatially reversed upon its agents as bodily enclosure.

baseline_models.mechanism: The chain root also carries easy flow and easy drinking, but the selected noun realizes linked restraint; the next root can lodge thirst-like heat inside, and the final root can intensify burning agitation. The sequence therefore supports an anti-flow mechanism: ease of passage is converted into binding while heat is trapped within and kindled without.

activation_trace.role: Smooth flow and easy drinking provide the latent mobility that the punishment sequence negates.
Linked chain-like connection converts the same root field from free passage into serial restraint.
Heat lodged in the belly, including unquenched thirst, supplies an interior pressure that cannot flow out.
Burning agitation, hunger, and thirst intensify the blocked-flow mechanism into affliction.

changed_reading.before: Chains, collars, and fire are three adjacent concrete penalties.
changed_reading.after: They can also form a material anti-flow sequence: passage becomes linkage, thirst becomes lodged heat, and heat becomes consuming agitation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding sequence makes the focus designation the disclosed outcome of a test: a created and perceptive human is shown a path, then appears as grateful or as one who covers favor. The punishment line follows the latter branch rather than introducing an unmotivated population.

activation_trace.role: Covering over a favor anchors the focus label in the response opposite gratitude.
A test that makes a condition visible supplies the disclosure process leading into the focus classification.
Gentle direction toward the path makes the later response occur after disclosed guidance.
An extended traversable road gives the test a directional field rather than a static label.
Recognizing a favor and praising its giver supplies the positive response against which focus كفر is legible.
Covering a favor supplies the negative fork that the focus plural immediately carries forward.

structural_cues: 76:2-3 runs creation and testing through hearing, sight, guidance, and the grateful/covering fork immediately before 76:4.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies test, faculties, guidance, path, and the opposed responses; I infer that 76:4 names the response revealed by that sequence. A live alternative is that كافر remains only a settled doctrinal category and the preceding process does not narrate its formation.

changed_reading.before: The punishment applies to a pre-existing generic class called the disbelievers.
changed_reading.after: The punishment follows the tested path's disclosed failure of gratitude: guided capacity hardens into covering the received favor.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the ayah boundary, the same root moves from كَافِرِينَ, the recipients of fire, to كَافُورًا, the aromatic admixture in the righteous cup. The rapid branch switch makes the focus word participate in a fire-to-drink counter-echo and shows that the root's covering field is not itself a single moral value.

activation_trace.role: Covering or rejecting truth supplies the focus's human and moral branch.
Aromatic camphor supplies the adjacent material branch, moving the same root from punished agent to pleasant drink admixture.

structural_cues: 76:4 ends with blazing fire for كَافِرِينَ; 76:5 immediately opens the righteous scene and ends with كَافُورًا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared root, distinct branches, adjacency, and fire/drink opposition; I infer a deliberate audible counter-echo. The materially live alternative is ordinary polysemy with no compositional linkage beyond proximity.

changed_reading.before: كَافِرِينَ is exhausted by its human designation inside the threat.
changed_reading.after: Its sound is immediately re-heard through كَافُورًا, sharpening the turn from blazing punishment to aromatic drink while keeping the branches semantically distinct.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly supplies drinking, mixed cups, flowing springs, forceful gushing, and being given drink. That context activates the easy-flow branch already latent in سَلَاسِلَ and turns the focus triad into the negative image of the reward system: flow is converted to linkage, inner thirst is trapped, and blaze replaces drink.

activation_trace.role: Easy flow and easy drinking provide the focus-root potential activated by the later drink system.
Linked connection realizes that root as immobilizing chains in the focus, creating the reversal.
Unquenched heat lodged in the belly makes denial of drink an interior condition as well as an external restraint.
Blazing fire supplies the destructive counterpart to the context's drink and springs.
Taking in liquid initiates the repeated reward-side flow that reverses focus restraint.
Mixing one substance with another makes reward fluid permeable and compositional, unlike the focus's closed links.
A source of running water supplies continuous emergence rather than immobilization.
Wide splitting and outflow make the spring actively breach confinement.
Giving drink completes the reward-side mechanism as supplied relief rather than trapped thirst.

structural_cues: 76:5-6 and 76:17-18 repeat cup, mixture, spring, and drink sequences around the long reward passage.
76:18 names the spring سَلْسَبِيلًا, audibly recalling focus سَلَاسِلَا and matching the focus inventory's easy-flow scope.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the focus root's flow/drink branch and the context's repeated fluid system; I infer a designed anti-flow reversal from free drink to binding. An alternative is a broad heaven/hell contrast in which the سَلَاسِل/سَلْسَبِيل resonance carries no additional mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus lists restraints and fire independently of the subsequent reward drinks.
changed_reading.after: The focus becomes an inverted hydraulic scene: the root capable of easy flow hardens into chain, thirst lodges inside, and fire occupies the place later filled by coursing drink.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same split root marks the human captive who is fed and the bodily bond or constitution that God strengthens. Set around the focus chains and collars, this distinguishes three relations to binding: humans answer an earthly captive with nourishment, God holds created bodies together, and final punitive restraint remains divine equipment.

activation_trace.role: Connected iron restraint anchors the focus side of the surah's distributed binding imagery.
A collar binding the body makes punitive bondage anatomically explicit.
Binding and confinement identify the captive as the person whom the righteous feed rather than further constrain.
Tight bodily formation and coherent joints turn binding into the divine cohesion by which human bodies exist.

structural_cues: 76:8 places أَسِيرًا among recipients of voluntary food.
76:28 says God created them and strengthened أَسْرَهُمْ, placing bodily cohesion under divine agency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies captivity, bodily cohesion, feeding, and focus restraints; I infer a jurisdictional contrast in which human virtue cares for captives while ultimate binding belongs to God. A live alternative treats earthly captivity, anatomy, and eschatological chains as separate uses with no normative allocation.

changed_reading.before: The chains and collars are generic images of captivity.
changed_reading.after: They sit inside a controlled ethics of binding: feed the human captive, recognize God as binder of the body, and reserve final punitive restraint to divine judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus preparation verb's split mapping activates counting as well as readying. Recompense language, precisely measured vessels, and the closing exact preparation verb together recast the punishment inventory as reckoned provision within a paired outcome economy, not uncontrolled combustion.

activation_trace.role: Enumerating what is counted activates a reckoning dimension inside the focus's split preparation root.
Preparing what is needed makes the punitive objects provisioned counterparts within that reckoning.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the context's explicit reciprocal logic.
A measure bringing a thing to its limit supplies exact fit on the reward side of the paired provisioning.
The closing verb directly repeats preparation through the dominant mapped root and seals the focus apparatus as held in readiness.

structural_cues: 76:12 and 76:22 explicitly name recompense, 76:16 emphasizes precise measure, and 76:31 repeats prepared punishment at the surah's close.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocity, measurement, and the exact preparation echo; I infer that calibration extends across the mirrored outcomes to the focus inventory. The live alternative is that measurement belongs only to serving vessels and licenses no claim about punitive proportion.

changed_reading.before: The punishment objects are simply stockpiled in advance.
changed_reading.after: They are prepared as reckoned counterparts inside a surah-wide system of recompense and fitted provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reward scene also covers and encircles bodies, but as clothing, adornment, and bracelets. This sharpens the focus's chains and collars into an anti-investiture: enclosure is not inherently punitive; its function changes from forced restraint to bestowed dignity.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies a neutral spatial operation whose moral function the two body-scenes differentiate.
A collar encircling and binding a limb supplies the punitive body-fitting form.
Clothing covers the rewarded body protectively and honorably rather than restraining it.
Adornment changes body-applied material from punitive hardware into bestowed beauty.
A bracelet encircling the hand gives a precise reward-side counterpart to the focus collar.

structural_cues: 76:21 clusters garments, silver bracelets, and pure drink on the rewarded body, reversing the focus cluster of chain, collar, and blaze.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies body-covering garments, encircling bracelets, and binding collars; I infer a deliberate anti-investiture topology. An alternative is that these are conventional independent descriptions of punishment and reward without body-site correspondence.

changed_reading.before: The focus restraint objects merely immobilize.
changed_reading.after: They are the negative counterpart of investiture: bodies are either forcibly enclosed by punitive hardware or honorably covered and encircled by bestowed dress.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later command not to obey a sinful person or kafur brings the focus class into a present social relation. Against that command, the final chains and collars become an agency reversal: the addressee must not yield to their direction now, while their own capacity for movement is finally restrained.

activation_trace.role: The focus's rejecter-of-truth designation identifies the party later placed in an obedience relation.
Bodily binding supplies the eventual restriction that reverses attempted direction of another's agency.
The repeated kafur places the focus category inside a present command about whom not to follow.
Compliance and obedience supply the agency relation that the command refuses.

structural_cues: 76:24 directly commands, within the patience charge, not to obey any sinner or kafur among them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated designation, refusal of obedience, and focus restraint; I infer a reversal between present attempted direction and final constrained agency. A live alternative reads 76:24 as pastoral instruction unrelated to the material form of 76:4's punishment.

changed_reading.before: The focus class matters only as a future recipient of punishment.
changed_reading.after: It also names a present source of pressure whose command must be refused; the final restraints answer a struggle over directed agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those described later prefer the immediate and put a heavy day behind them, yet the focus preparation root images punishment as already prepared and present. Their temporal strategy of relegating consequence behind the back therefore fails: what they conceal as remote is materially held ready.

activation_trace.role: Prepared-and-present readiness makes the supposedly deferred consequence already available.
Covering supplies the focus-side action that can now operate temporally by hiding consequence.
Haste and bringing forward supply preference for the immediate temporal horizon.
Leaving something supplies the deliberate abandonment of the other horizon.
Putting a thing behind the back supplies spatial concealment for the deferred day.
Weight against lightness gives the abandoned day material pressure despite its attempted removal from view.

structural_cues: 76:27 opposes love of العاجلة to leaving a heavy day behind, while 76:4 has already declared the punitive equipment prepared.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediacy, abandonment, behindness, heaviness, and prepared presence; I infer that temporal concealment is answered by prepositioned consequence. An alternative is that عتد denotes simple future preparation with no paradoxical presentness.

changed_reading.before: The ayah announces equipment for a remote future punishment.
changed_reading.after: It defeats the coverer's temporal evasion: the heavy future placed out of sight is already prepared and present.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final ayah repeats prepared punishment but names the recipients as wrongdoers. Its branches add misplacement and withholding from right, so the focus's covering of truth or favor is reframed as an unjust disorder, while the exact preparation echo brackets the entire intervening reward scene.

activation_trace.role: Covering or rejecting truth anchors the opening recipient description.
Preparation supplies the opening half of the punishment bracket.
Putting something outside its proper time or place adds disorder and misplacement to the closing recipient description.
Withholding and confinement from a right supplies the social-moral edge of the closing diagnosis.
The repeated readying verb closes the bracket with the same preparation mechanism as the focus.

structural_cues: 76:4 opens the outcome contrast with prepared chains, collars, and blaze; 76:31 closes the surah with prepared painful punishment after mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the preparation echo and the shift from kafirin to zalimin; I infer that the close morally redescribes the opening class through misplacement and withholding. A live alternative is parallel extension to overlapping groups rather than a gloss or redescription.

changed_reading.before: 76:4 is an isolated threat before the reward description.
changed_reading.after: It is the opening half of a surah-wide bracket: covering is revisited as unjust misplacement or withholding, and prepared punishment encloses the intervening alternatives.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from the literal collar branch of أَغْلَال to the same root's hidden-rancor branch and then contrasts it with hidden joy in سُرُورًا. It remains anchored in the focus noun and packet branches, but downstream prose should present it as an associative exteriorization of inward states, never as the lexical translation of أَغْلَال.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَغْلَالًا as both binding collar and an activator of concealed rancor

activation_trace.role: Rancor hidden in the chest supplies an inward form of constriction that can be exteriorized by the focus collar.
The binding collar supplies the concrete exterior form of that inward captivity.
Hidden joy and ease supply the rewarded inward counterpart to concealed rancor.

changed_reading.before: The collars constrain only from outside.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the collar can materialize an inward captivity of concealed rancor, countered in the reward sequence by inward joy.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is form-distant because it activates the vessel branch of ع ت د and the dug-oven branch of س ع ر against the next ayah's cup. It remains anchored in two focus roots and the adjacent context vessel, but it should be rendered only as a dark hospitality or anti-banquet echo, not by translating أَعْتَدْنَا as a vessel or سَعِيرًا as an oven.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَعْتَدْنَا and سَعِيرًا as latent equipment and oven images around the adjacent cup scene

activation_trace.role: The vessel called عتاد supplies a form-distant container image inside the focus preparation root.
A dug baking oven supplies destructive prepared heat as the dark equipment of the focus scene.
The cup together with what it contains supplies the immediate hospitable counterpart to the punitive equipment.

changed_reading.before: Preparation introduces penal hardware, followed independently by a reward cup.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the focus shadows the coming banquet with an anti-banquet: a destructive prepared container-and-oven complex before the cup of the righteous.

strongest_changes: The creation-test-guidance sequence turns the focus class from a static label into the disclosed failure of the grateful branch.
The adjacent كَافِرِينَ/كَافُورًا switch and the repeated drink-spring system transform chains, lodged thirst, and blaze into a tightly structured anti-flow scene.
The captive who is fed and the bodily bond God strengthens sharply delimit punitive binding as divine judgment rather than a model for human treatment of captives.
Clothing and silver bracelets reverse collars into an anti-investiture, distinguishing forced enclosure from honorable covering and encirclement.
Love of the immediate and placement of the heavy day behind make prepared-and-present punishment answer temporal concealment.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package exposed unusually dense material reversals around one short punitive line: covering becomes either denial or garment, encirclement becomes collar or bracelet, the chain root's easy-flow potential reappears in Salsabil, and the split preparation root is confirmed by the closing أَعَدَّ. These changes coexist rather than resolve into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The compositional force of the كَافِرِينَ/كَافُورًا and سَلَاسِلَا/سَلْسَبِيلًا echoes may be intentional architecture or merely activated polysemy and sound proximity.
The measured vessels clearly support fitted reward; extending their calibration logic to punishment remains an inference.
The captive/body-constitution pairing strongly activates a jurisdictional contrast, but the packet does not itself state that normative arrow.
The inward-captivity and anti-banquet outliers rely on form-distant branches and must remain explicitly exploratory.
